markdown_content: ## Overview of Colorway Assigning in CLO 2025.0 This section explains the two main methods for assigning colorways in CLO 2025.0: the simple method aimed at most users, and a more advanced approach allowing custom settings. It introduces key terminology such as materials, all properties, and linking within the property editor, and outlines their effects on colorway customization. - **Materials**: Only material-related properties (color, texture) change per colorway. - **All Properties**: All properties in the property editor change individually for each colorway. - **Linking**: All properties, including materials, are linked across all colorways, causing simultaneous changes. Materials and physical properties can be mixed; for example, colors and textures can differ across colorways while physical fabric properties remain consistent. The example fabric used is a bright red to illustrate these differences. --- ## Drag-and-Drop Behavior in 3D Window vs. Colorway Editor This section covers how dragging and dropping fabrics or colors in the 3D window differs from doing so in the colorway editor, highlighting the impact on patterns and fabrics. ### In the 3D Window: - Drag-and-drop edits the **pattern**, not the fabric itself. - Assign options when dragging in 3D: - **Assign to Current Colorway Only**: Changes affect only the selected pattern piece in the current colorway. - **Assign to All Colorways by Unlinking Materials**: Changes material properties across all colorways but keeps other properties unlinked. - **Assign to All Colorways by Linking All Properties**: All properties (including materials) are linked across colorways; changes apply globally. Example: Dragging a red fabric onto a pattern piece and assigning to all colorways with unlinking materials changes the material across all colorways without affecting physical properties. ### In the Colorway Editor: - Drag-and-drop affects the **colorway** directly. - Same three assign options are available: - Current colorway only - All colorways by unlinking materials - All colorways by linking all properties Example: Dragging a fabric onto one colorway only changes that colorway. Dragging with unlinking materials allows material changes across multiple colorways while keeping physical properties separate. Linking all properties causes simultaneous changes in all linked colorways. --- ## Explanation of Assign Options This section defines each assign mode in detail for clarity: 1. **Assign to Current Colorway Only** Changes affect only the active colorway, without modifying others. 2. **Assign to All Colorways by Unlinking Materials** Material properties (color, texture) change across all colorways, but other properties remain independent. Useful for changing colors while preserving physical fabric behavior. 3. **Assign to All Colorways by Linking All Properties** All properties, including physical and material, are linked across colorways. Changing one colorway updates all others identically. --- ## Practical Example of Assigning Colorways This section presents a step-by-step example demonstrating how to assign fabrics and colors using the different assign options. - Created a bright red fabric to illustrate. - Dragging fabric onto pattern piece in 3D with "Assign to Current Colorway Only" affects only that piece in that colorway. - Using "Assign to All Colorways by Unlinking Materials" changes material properties for all colorways, allowing color changes without altering physical fabric properties. - Using "Assign to All Colorways by Linking All Properties" links all colorways, so changing one changes all. - In the colorway editor, drag-and-drop works similarly but directly edits colorways. - Materials can be selected and edited across multiple colorways after unlinking materials. --- ## User Settings for Default Assign Option This section explains how to configure the default assign behavior in CLO 2025.0 for drag-and-drop operations. - Access via **Top Toolbar > Settings > User Settings > Other > Colorway**. - Choose the default assign mode: - Assign to Current Colorway Only - Assign to All Colorways (with options for materials or linking) - This setting determines the first option shown when dragging and dropping fabrics or colors. - Users can still override defaults by holding Control to cycle through options during assignment. Configuring this default streamlines workflow based on individual preferences. --- ## Summary of Key Points - Colorway assignment in CLO 2025.0 supports flexible control over material and property linkage. - Drag-and-drop edits pattern properties in 3D window; edits colorways directly in the colorway editor. - Three assign modes control scope and linkage of changes: current colorway only, all colorways with unlinking materials, and all colorways with linking all properties. - Physical fabric properties can remain consistent while material appearance varies per colorway. - User settings allow customization of default assignment behavior to improve efficiency. This detailed understanding enables precise control of fabric and color assignment workflows in CLO 2025.0.
